notes.legacyJinjaLayer: templates/** and static/style.css are the frozen legacy Jinja look (Chakra Petch, dark/red) kept live until each page is ported to React — the strangler rollout the user chose on 8 Sep 2026. DESIGN.md scopes them out; they are not reviewed against it. Remove these ignores when the last Jinja page goes.
notes.scratchpadDocs: Session scratchpad holds standalone documents (plans, audit reports) published as artifacts. They borrow Odin's palette and typeface on purpose but are documents, not the product UI — DESIGN.md's type ramp and radius scale describe app components and do not apply to them.
